finding: User allowlisting !/_headers overrode the default metadata exclusion. Initial product preview served the exact 641-byte policy file with status 200. The file contains policy, not credentials.
inspection: createAssetsIgnoreFunction prepends metadata exclusions then appends user rules; getAssetsOptions independently reads _headers; createWorkerUploadForm includes it as deployment metadata. Removing the allowlist exception preserves parsing and prevents public asset serving.
fix: Remove !/_headers; keep the physical file; verify actual HTTP headers and 404 for /_headers on the corrected preview.
